quarterly_data.signal: Lite-On deck: DenseLight is a Singapore InP optical communications component IDM spanning epitaxy, wafer fabrication, laser components and packaging & testing, with a strong focus on InP CW DFB lasers and ELS solutions for AI high-speed optical modules and a diversified global customer base. Key data-center products: InP-based CW DFB lasers supporting 800G / 1.6T front-end and back-end, and a coherent comms laser gain chip for 800G / 1.6T-ZR and TX-SOA for 800G-ZR. Lite-On's investment gives it a ~21.22% shareholding (based on 88,403,059 shares outstanding after the investment) and one board seat.
